pages.text: The vessel has two item inputs, one item output, and one fluid tank. Required items, fluid, and Source are reserved when a recipe starts and consumed together when it finishes. Items and fluids may enter or leave from any side.

An empty bucket can package 1,000 mB of water, lava, or milk in one second without Source. Filled buckets do not stack, so remove them with a hopper or similar device. See Arcane Reaction in JEI for exact recipes and costs.
